title: Block Disentanglement in CRL: Bridging Identifiability and Visual State Estimation
title_zh: CRL中的块解纠缠：连接可识别性与视觉状态估计

paragraphs.en: Causal representation learning (CRL) is the process of recovering causally-related latent variables from high-dimensional observations. As a label-free inference method, CRL is particularly attractive for applications where data labels are unavailable or impractical to obtain. While there has been significant progress in understanding the identifiability guarantees of CRL, such guarantees often hold under highly stylized assumptions, which temper the direct application to real-world problems. This paper has a two-fold objective for interventional CRL. First, it establishes identifiability guarantees for substantially weaker interventional assumptions, resulting in block disentanglement of the causal variables, where the block structure depends on the realistically available intervention mechanisms. Secondly, the block disentanglement framework is used for embodied visual state estimation, in which the objective is to recover the latent physical variables of a robotic system directly from visual data (images and videos) without labeled data . These two components are critically complementary. The block disentanglement theory delineates identifiability guarantees under weakened assumptions, and the application demonstrates that the resulting objective remains effective in a controlled embodied setting despite further assumption violations, providing a theory-to-practice bridge needed to translate the promise of label-free CRL into practical problems.
paragraphs.zh: 因果表示学习（CRL）是从高维观测数据中恢复具有因果关系的潜在变量的过程。 作为一种无标签推断方法，CRL在数据标签不可用或难以获取的应用场景中尤其具有吸引力。 尽管对CRL可识别性保证的理解已取得显著进展，但这些保证通常依赖于高度理想化的假设，从而限制了其在现实问题中的直接应用。 本文针对干预式CRL提出了双重目标。 首先，它在大幅弱化的干预假设下建立了可识别性保证，从而实现了对因果变量的块状解耦，其中块结构取决于实际可用的干预机制。 其次，该块状解耦框架被用于具身视觉状态估计，其目标是从视觉数据（图像和视频）中直接恢复机器人系统的潜在物理变量，而无需依赖带标签的数据。 这两个组成部分具有关键的互补性。 块状解耦理论界定了在弱化假设下的可识别性保证，而该应用则表明，尽管存在进一步的假设违背，由此得到的目标在受控的具身环境中依然有效，从而架起了将无标签CRL的潜力转化为实际解决方案所需的理论与实践桥梁。

paragraphs.en: Physical systems are generally described by a set of state variables needed to characterize the systems’ condition, in conjunction with the physical laws that delineate how these variables causally influence one another. These variables and causal mechanisms determine how the system evolves and responds to different forms of external stimulation or interventions. In many applications, however, these variables and mechanisms are not observed directly. Instead, the system is monitored or perceived through high-dimensional sensory systems (e.g., images and videos). This creates a fundamental need to recover hidden variables and causal mechanisms from high-dimensional observable data. Such recovery is critical for meaningful reasoning about the system (e.g., how the system responds to hypothetical stimuli) and for transferring models across environments with distributional shifts.
paragraphs.zh: 物理系统通常由一组描述系统状态的状态变量以及阐明这些变量如何相互因果作用的物理定律共同定义。 这些变量和因果机制决定了系统的演化方式，以及它如何对不同类型的外部刺激或干预作出响应。 然而，在许多应用中，这些变量和机制并非直接可观测的。 相反，系统是通过高维感官系统（例如图像和视频）进行监测或感知的。 这就产生了一个根本性需求：从高维可观测数据中恢复隐藏变量和因果机制。 这种恢复对于对系统进行有意义的推理（例如系统如何响应假设性刺激）以及将模型迁移到分布发生变化的环境中至关重要。

paragraphs.en: The recovered latent models and mechanisms must be provably correct, generating system representations that specify the true underlying system state variables. Supervised learning offers a direct solution to this, but it is label-intensive and requires large-scale per-sample labels, which are often unavailable due to expense and complexity of curating annotated and labeled data. To address this challenge, identifiable representation learning circumvents dependence on labeled data while providing provably correct recovery without per-sample supervision.
paragraphs.zh: 恢复出的潜在模型和机制必须具有可证明的正确性，从而生成能够指定真实底层系统状态变量的系统表示。 监督学习为此问题提供了直接解决方案，但它高度依赖标签，需要大规模的单样本标签，而由于标注数据整理工作的成本高昂和复杂性，这些标签通常无法获取。 为应对这一挑战，可识别表示学习无需依赖标注数据，同时能够在没有单样本监督的情况下实现具有可证明正确性的恢复。

paragraphs.en: Causal representation learning (CRL) has emerged as a form of identifiable representation learning apt for physical systems. Specifically, it is formed at the confluence of three primary research directions: (i) disentangling generative factors embedded in high-dimensional data, (ii) causal inference, and (iii) representation learning. Because a system’s variables are not necessarily statistically independent (they are coupled through complex interactions), CRL aims to jointly disentangle them and learn the causal mechanisms that connect them ( Schölkopf et al., 2021 ) . Such causal mechanisms represent stable conditional laws relating causes to effects. Extensive studies in recent years have established the identifiability limits of CRL, establishing when latent causal factors are recoverable; for representative studies see ( Varıcı et al., 2025 ; Ahuja et al., 2023 ; Yao et al., 2025 ; Ng et al., 2025 ) . In parallel, there has been an active interest in translating these CRL guarantees into applications in genomics ( Tejada-Lapuerta et al., 2025 ) , biomedical ( Sun et al., 2025 ) , and dynamical systems ( Yao et al., 2024 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 因果表示学习（CRL）已成为一种适用于物理系统的可识别表示学习方法。 具体而言，它是在三个主要研究方向的交汇点形成的：(i) 解耦高维数据中嵌入的生成因素，(ii) 因果推断，以及 (iii) 表示学习。 由于一个系统的变量并不一定在统计上相互独立（它们通过复杂的相互作用耦合在一起），CRL旨在联合解耦这些变量，并学习连接它们的因果机制（Schölkopf 等，2021）。 这类因果机制代表了将原因与结果联系起来的稳定条件规律。 近年来大量研究确立了 CRL 的可识别性边界，明确了潜在因果因素在何种情况下可以被恢复；代表性研究参见（Varıcı 等，2025；Ahuja 等，2023；Yao 等，2025；Ng 等，2025）。 与此同时，学界也积极致力于将这些 CRL 理论保障转化为基因组学（Tejada-Lapuerta 等，2025）、生物医学（Sun 等，2025）和动态系统（Yao 等，2024）领域的应用。

sents.en: Causal representation learning (CRL) has emerged as a form of identifiable representation learning apt for physical systems.
sents.zh: 因果表示学习（CRL）已成为一种适用于物理系统的可识别表示学习方法。

paragraphs.en: A particularly important application with growing interest in which CRL offers a natural solution is the analysis of video observations of physical systems (e.g., robots), where the objective is recovering the latent state variables from image sequences without requiring frame-by-frame labels ( Lippe et al., 2023b ; Lippe et al., 2023a ; Chen et al., 2025 ) . A video provides a high-dimensional record of how the physical system evolves and responds to external inputs, while the true variables (e.g., a robot’s positions, orientations, and velocity) are hidden and embedded in the video record. In such applications, while videos are readily and inexpensively available, annotating each frame is prohibitively laborious and costly. Therefore, this is a setting in which CRL can offer significant potential by identifying and recovering latent variables and their causal dynamics directly from unlabeled video.
paragraphs.zh: 一个日益受到关注且CRL能提供自然解决方案的重要应用，是对物理系统（例如机器人）的视频观察进行分析，其目标是从图像序列中恢复潜在状态变量，而无需逐帧标注（Lippe et al., 2023b；Lippe et al., 2023a；Chen et al., 2025）。 视频提供了关于物理系统如何演化以及对外部输入做出响应的高维记录，而真实变量（例如机器人的位置、朝向和速度）则是隐藏的，并嵌入在视频记录中。 在此类应用中，尽管视频可以轻松且低成本地获取，但为每一帧进行标注却极其费力且成本高昂。 因此，在这一场景下，CRL能够通过直接从无标签视频中识别和恢复潜在变量及其因果动态，展现出巨大的潜力。

sents.zh: 在此类应用中，尽管视频可以轻松且低成本地获取，但为每一帧进行标注却极其费力且成本高昂。

sents.en: Therefore, this is a setting in which CRL can offer significant potential by identifying and recovering latent variables and their causal dynamics directly from unlabeled video.
sents.zh: 因此，在这一场景下，CRL能够通过直接从无标签视频中识别和恢复潜在变量及其因果动态，展现出巨大的潜力。

paragraphs.en: Achieving these objectives in videos, however, necessitates operationalizing CRL in regimes beyond what the current CRL theory covers. Specifically, while identifiability results in CRL often provide strong guarantees, they also rely on collectively strong assumptions such as access to counterfactual observations; atomic (single-node) intervention targets; stochastic hard or d ​ o do interventions; independent samples; exhaustive interventional diversity; and an exactly known latent dimensionality. While each of these assumptions can be justifiably valid in certain settings, in real-world settings, such as systems evolving continuously over time, they might not all be satisfied simultaneously . Challenges that violate this set of assumptions include sequential access to information and partial or imperfect interventions with unknown targets. As a result, the gap between identifiable CRL theory and label-free state recovery from video is fundamentally a gap in the joint validity of the assumptions required by existing guarantees. For more discussion on the existing CRL guarantees and their attendant assumptions, we refer to Appendix A .
paragraphs.zh: 然而，要在视频中实现这些目标，就需要将CRL应用于当前CRL理论所涵盖范围之外的场景。 具体而言，尽管CRL中的可识别性结果通常能提供强有力的保障，但它们也依赖于一系列集体性强且严格的假设，例如能够获取反事实观测数据；以原子（单节点）方式实施干预；执行随机硬性或d o do干预；样本相互独立；干预方式具有全面多样性；以及潜在维数完全已知。 尽管这些假设中的每一项在某些情境下都可能合理成立，但在现实世界中——例如系统随时间持续演化的情形——它们可能无法同时满足。 违反这一系列假设的挑战包括信息的顺序获取，以及目标未知或部分且不完整的干预。 因此，可识别的CRL理论与从视频中恢复无标签状态之间的差距，本质上在于现有保障所依赖的假设能否共同成立。 关于现有CRL保障及其相关假设的更多讨论，请参见附录A。

paragraphs.en: To bridge the gap between current CRL theory and practical visual state estimation, we take two complementary steps, one theoretical and one empirical. Both are critically needed, as they address different but complementary obstacles.
paragraphs.zh: 为了弥合当前 CRL 理论与实际视觉状态估计之间的差距，我们采取了两个互补的步骤：一个理论步骤，一个经验步骤。 两者都至关重要，因为它们分别应对了不同但相互补充的障碍。

sents.en: To bridge the gap between current CRL theory and practical visual state estimation, we take two complementary steps, one theoretical and one empirical.
sents.zh: 为了弥合当前 CRL 理论与实际视觉状态估计之间的差距，我们采取了两个互补的步骤：一个理论步骤，一个经验步骤。

sents.en: Both are critically needed, as they address different but complementary obstacles.
sents.zh: 两者都至关重要，因为它们分别应对了不同但相互补充的障碍。

paragraphs.en: Theoretical bridge: The theoretical step weakens the intervention assumptions required for identifiability. Specifically, current CRL theory focuses on disentangling individual variables, which in turn often necessitates intervention structures that isolate one variable at a time. To address this, we consider block disentanglement , and establish conditions under which an intervened block of variables remains identifiable even when individual variables cannot be disentangled separately.
paragraphs.zh: 理论桥梁：理论步骤削弱了可识别性所需的干预假设。 具体而言，当前的 CRL 理论专注于解耦各个变量，而这通常要求采用每次仅隔离一个变量的干预结构。 为了解决这个问题，我们考虑了块解耦方法，并建立了在无法单独解耦各个变量的情况下，被干预的变量块仍然保持可识别性的条件。

sents.en: Theoretical bridge: The theoretical step weakens the intervention assumptions required for identifiability.
sents.zh: 理论桥梁：理论步骤削弱了可识别性所需的干预假设。

sents.en: Specifically, current CRL theory focuses on disentangling individual variables, which in turn often necessitates intervention structures that isolate one variable at a time.
sents.zh: 具体而言，当前的 CRL 理论专注于解耦各个变量，而这通常要求采用每次仅隔离一个变量的干预结构。

sents.en: To address this, we consider block disentanglement , and establish conditions under which an intervened block of variables remains identifiable even when individual variables cannot be disentangled separately.
sents.zh: 为了解决这个问题，我们考虑了块解耦方法，并建立了在无法单独解耦各个变量的情况下，被干预的变量块仍然保持可识别性的条件。

paragraphs.en: Empirical bridge: On the empirical side, we further weaken the assumptions and investigate whether the resulting block disentanglement principle remains effective when applied to embodied visual data, where temporal dependence, imperfect intervention effects, and uncertainty in the latent representation arise naturally. For this purpose, robotics is a natural target and has long motivated CRL ( Schölkopf et al., 2021 ) : an effective robotic world model must capture the causal factors governing the robot’s state and its interaction with the environment. In our experiments, we show that even under extensive assumption violations, the proposed method retains significant information about the “active block” of variables in a simulated robot pose estimation task.
paragraphs.zh: 经验层面：在经验层面，我们进一步放宽了假设，并研究了由此得出的块解耦原则在应用于具身视觉数据时是否仍然有效——在这些数据中，时间依赖性、不完美的干预效应以及潜在表示中的不确定性会自然出现。 为此，机器人技术是一个天然的研究目标，并且长期以来一直是 CRL（Schölkopf 等人，2021）的驱动力：一个有效的机器人世界模型必须能够捕捉到控制机器人状态及其与环境交互的因果因素。 在我们的实验中，我们表明，即使在假设被广泛违反的情况下，所提出的方法在模拟的机器人姿态估计任务中仍然保留了关于变量“活跃块”的重要信息。

sents.en: Empirical bridge: On the empirical side, we further weaken the assumptions and investigate whether the resulting block disentanglement principle remains effective when applied to embodied visual data, where temporal dependence, imperfect intervention effects, and uncertainty in the latent representation arise naturally.
sents.zh: 经验层面：在经验层面，我们进一步放宽了假设，并研究了由此得出的块解耦原则在应用于具身视觉数据时是否仍然有效——在这些数据中，时间依赖性、不完美的干预效应以及潜在表示中的不确定性会自然出现。

sents.en: For this purpose, robotics is a natural target and has long motivated CRL ( Schölkopf et al., 2021 ) : an effective robotic world model must capture the causal factors governing the robot’s state and its interaction with the environment.

sents.en: In our experiments, we show that even under extensive assumption violations, the proposed method retains significant information about the “active block” of variables in a simulated robot pose estimation task.
sents.zh: 在我们的实验中，我们表明，即使在假设被广泛违反的情况下，所提出的方法在模拟的机器人姿态估计任务中仍然保留了关于变量“活跃块”的重要信息。

paragraphs.en: Collectively, our results demonstrate that interventional CRL remains highly effective beyond stringent regimes defined by stylized assumptions. We achieve this by relaxing the identifiability target from individual causal variables to an intervention-defined block under weaker conditions; the resulting block disentanglement principle remains effective even when experimental data further depart from the theoretical requirements. Accordingly, our results point to a step-by-step transition in which progressively weaker theoretical and empirical conditions still yield useful representation learning objectives.
paragraphs.zh: 总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，干预性 CRL 在超越由程式化假设所定义严格制度之后，依然保持高度有效。 我们通过将可识别性目标从个体因果变量放宽至在较弱条件下由干预定义的模块来实现这一点；由此产生的模块解纠缠原则即使在实验数据进一步偏离理论要求时仍然有效。 因此，我们的研究结果指出了一种逐步过渡的过程：在此过程中，理论上和实证上逐渐减弱的条件仍能产生有用的表示学习目标。

paragraphs.en: The main objective in CRL is to use observational data X X to recover the latent variables Z Z and the latent causal graph 𝒢 \mathcal{G} . Identifiability in CRL pertains to establishing conditions under which a unique equivalence class of models explains the observed data. Existing CRL identifiability results mainly focus on elementwise disentanglement of Z Z , that is, recovering the variables { Z i : i ∈ [ n ] } \{Z_{i}:i\in[n]\} individually ( Squires et al., 2023 ; Buchholz et al., 2023 ; Zhang et al., 2023 ; von Kügelgen et al., 2023 ; Varıcı et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2024 ) . However, these results generally require strong assumptions. In contrast, a more relaxed identifiability target, block disentanglement , has received relatively less attention ( Ahuja et al., 2023 ; Liang et al., 2023 ; Yao et al., 2025 ) . In our theoretical analysis, we aim to prove block disentanglement under weaker conditions on data availability. For completeness, we formally define both types of disentanglement as follows.
paragraphs.zh: CRL 的主要目标是利用观测数据 X X 恢复潜在变量 Z Z 和潜在因果图 𝒢 \mathcal{G}。 CRL 中的可识别性涉及确定在何种条件下，存在一个唯一的模型等价类能够解释观测数据。 现有的 CRL 可识别性研究主要关注 Z Z 的逐元素解耦，即分别恢复变量 { Z i : i ∈ [ n ] } \{Z_{i}:i\in[n]\}（Squires et al., 2023；Buchholz et al., 2023；Zhang et al., 2023；von Kügelgen et al., 2023；Varıcı et al., 2025；Chen et al., 2024）。 然而，这些结果通常需要较强的假设。 相比之下，一种更宽松的可识别性目标——块解耦——则相对较少受到关注（Ahuja et al., 2023；Liang et al., 2023；Yao et al., 2025）。 在我们的理论分析中，我们旨在数据可用性的条件下以更弱的假设证明块解耦。 为求完整，我们对这两种解耦类型进行如下正式定义。

paragraphs.zh: 我们称 Z ^ \smash{\hat{Z}} 实现了 ℐ ⊆ [ n ] \mathcal{I}\subseteq[n] 的块解纠缠，如果存在一个大小为 | ℐ | |\mathcal{I}| 的子集 ℐ ^ ⊆ [ n ] \hat{\mathcal{I}}\subseteq[n] 和一个微分同胚 ϕ ℐ : ℝ | ℐ | → ℝ | ℐ | \phi_{\mathcal{I}}:{\mathbb{R}}^{|\mathcal{I}|}\to{\mathbb{R}}^{|\mathcal{I}|}，使得 Z ^ ℐ ^ = ϕ ℐ ​ ( Z ℐ ) \smash{\hat{Z}_{\hat{\mathcal{I}}}}=\phi_{\mathcal{I}}(Z_{\mathcal{I}}) 成立。

paragraphs.en: Hence, elementwise disentanglement states that all latent variables are recovered up to a permutation and elementwise transformations, whereas block disentanglement states that the estimate Z ^ ℐ ^ \smash{\hat{Z}_{\hat{\mathcal{I}}}} of block ℐ \mathcal{I} is an invertible function of the true block Z ℐ Z_{\mathcal{I}} without leakage from other variables or noise.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，逐元素解纠缠指出，所有潜在变量都可以被恢复（最多相差一个排列和逐元素变换），而块解纠缠则指出，对于块 ℐ \mathcal{I}，其估计值 Z ^ ℐ ^ \smash{\hat{Z}_{\hat{\mathcal{I}}}} 是真实块 Z ℐ Z_{\mathcal{I}} 的一个可逆函数，且不存在来自其他变量或噪声的泄露。

paragraphs.en: Existing results obtain identifiability under different tradeoffs between intervention structure and assumptions on the latent model or observation map. In the general nonlinear setting closest to ours, ( von Kügelgen et al., 2023 ; Varıcı et al., 2025 ) establish elementwise disentanglement under (C1)–(C6): interventions are atomic and hard, with paired interventions satisfying the node-wise discrepancy condition. Other works in the literature operate under additional structural assumptions, such as linear transformations, linear causal models, or known causal graphs ( Squires et al., 2023 ; Buchholz et al., 2023 ; Zhang et al., 2023 ; Ahuja et al., 2023 ; Liang et al., 2023 ; Yao et al., 2025 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 现有研究在不同干预结构与潜在模型或观测映射假设之间的权衡下，获得了可识别性。 在与我们研究最接近的一般非线性设定中，（von Kügelgen 等人，2023；Varıcı 等人，2025）在（C1）–（C6）条件下建立了逐元素的解耦：干预是原子性的且难以实现，同时成对干预需满足节点级差异条件。 文献中的其他研究则基于额外的结构假设展开，例如线性变换、线性因果模型或已知的因果图（Squires 等人，2023；Buchholz 等人，2023；Zhang 等人，2023；Ahuja 等人，2023；Liang 等人，2023；Yao 等人，2025）。

paragraphs.en: In this paper, we relax assumptions (C1)–(C6) in two stages. The first stage forms the theoretical bridge : we replace assumptions (C1)–(C4) with weaker ones and establish identifiability results in the form of block-disentanglement guarantees. Crucially, these replacement assumptions impose collectively less stringent conditions on the power, coverage, and diversity of the interventions. The second stage forms the empirical bridge : we move beyond the theory by considering settings that additionally violate (C5) and (C6). Together, these two stages allow us to provide empirical evidence for disentanglement from visual data under substantially weaker conditions than those considered in the existing literature.
paragraphs.zh: 在本文中，我们分两个阶段放宽假设 (C1)–(C6)。 第一阶段构建了理论桥梁：我们将假设 (C1)–(C4) 替换为更弱的假设，并建立了以块解纠缠保证形式呈现的可识别性结果。 关键在于，这些替代假设共同对干预措施的力量、覆盖范围和多样性施加了较不严格的条件。 第二阶段构建了经验桥梁：我们通过考虑额外违反 (C5) 和 (C6) 的情形，超越了理论范畴。 这两个阶段共同使我们能够在比现有文献所考虑的条件弱得多的情况下，为从视觉数据中实现解纠缠提供经验证据。

paragraphs.en: Definitions 2 and 3 replace the canonical interventional assumptions (C1)–(C4). Rather than constraining each intervention individually to be atomic, hard, paired, or sufficiently distinct, these definitions impose only aggregate structural conditions on the collection of interventional environments. Definition 2 ensures that intervention-induced score differences remain confined to the active block ℐ \mathcal{I} , while Definition 3 requires that these score differences collectively span that block.
paragraphs.zh: 定义 2 和定义 3 取代了经典的干预假设 (C1)–(C4)。 这些定义并未将每次干预单独限制为原子性、硬性、成对或足够区分，而是仅对干预环境的集合施加聚合结构条件。 定义 2 确保由干预引起的分数差异仅限于活动块 ℐ \mathcal{I}，而定义 3 则要求这些分数差异共同覆盖该块。

sents.en: Definition 2 ensures that intervention-induced score differences remain confined to the active block ℐ \mathcal{I} , while Definition 3 requires that these score differences collectively span that block.
sents.zh: 定义 2 确保由干预引起的分数差异仅限于活动块 ℐ \mathcal{I}，而定义 3 则要求这些分数差异共同覆盖该块。

paragraphs.en: Specifically, Definition 3 is the block-level counterpart of the interventional discrepancy condition (C4). This condition is satisfied by K ≥ | ℐ | K\geq|\mathcal{I}| multi-node interventional environments as long as their score difference directions span the active subspace almost everywhere. Furthermore, this condition is strictly weaker than the canonical full-coverage intervention structure in (C1)–(C4). In particular, under (C1)–(C4), taking score differences between the paired hard-intervention environments produces one nonzero direction per intervened coordinate, and hence satisfies Definition 3 . The converse does not hold: collective rank diversity permits unpaired, multi-node, and soft interventions, provided their score difference directions jointly span the active block. Hence, the two definitions replace intervention-by-intervention restrictions with collective conditions on support and span, substantially relaxing the intervention structure while retaining a nontrivial identifiability guarantee. Leveraging these definitions, we provide sufficient conditions for the block-identifiability result formalized next.
paragraphs.zh: 具体而言，定义3是干预性差异条件（C4）在块层面上的对应形式。 只要这些多节点干预环境的得分差异方向几乎处处张成活跃子空间，那么当 K ≥ | ℐ | K\geq|\mathcal{I}| 时，该条件即被满足。 此外，该条件严格弱于（C1）–（C4）中标准的完全覆盖干预结构。 特别地，在（C1）–（C4）条件下，计算成对硬干预环境之间的得分差异，会为每个受干预的坐标产生一个非零方向，从而满足定义3。 反之则不成立：集体秩多样性允许未配对、多节点和软干预，只要它们的得分差异方向共同张成活跃块即可。 因此，这两个定义将逐次干预的限制替换为对支撑集和张成的集体条件，在保持非平凡的可识别性保证的同时，显著放宽了干预结构。 利用这些定义，我们为接下来形式化的块可识别性结果提供充分条件。

paragraphs.en: Existing block-identifiability results rely on substantially different structural information. von Kügelgen et al. (2021) established the concept under counterfactual CRL setting. In interventional CRL, ( Ahuja et al., 2023 ) obtains a block-affine identification result by exploiting intervention-induced support independence, and ( Liang et al., 2023 ) assumes that the causal graph and intervention targets are known and require multiple perfect interventions on the same target block satisfying a block-interventional discrepancy condition. Most closely related setting is ( Yao et al., 2025 ) which provides a general invariance-based framework for block identifiability: latent blocks that remain invariant can be identified. In contrast, our block disentanglement target ℐ \mathcal{I} is precisely the intervention-affected (i.e., varying ) block.
paragraphs.zh: 现有的块可识别性研究结果依赖于结构信息存在显著差异。von Kügelgen 等人 （2021）在反事实 CRL 设定下确立了这一概念。 在干预性 CRL 中，（Ahuja 等人，2023）通过利用干预引发的支撑独立性获得了块仿射识别结果；而（Liang 等人，2023）则假设因果图和干预目标是已知的，并要求对同一目标块进行多次完美干预，以满足块干预差异条件。 最相关的设定是（Yao 等人，2025），该研究为块可识别性提供了一个基于不变性的通用框架：保持不变的潜在块可以被识别出来。 相比之下，我们的块解纠缠目标 ℐ \mathcal{I} 正是受干预影响（即发生变化的）块。

paragraphs.en: The theoretical bridge in Section 3 already relaxes assumptions (C1)–(C4), while retaining (C5)–(C6), and establishes block-disentanglement guarantees under this weaker setting. The next question is whether the resulting CRL principles remain effective when we move further toward practical visual state estimation and additionally relax (C5)–(C6). This constitutes our empirical bridge .
paragraphs.zh: 第 3 节中的理论性桥梁已经放宽了假设 (C1)–(C4)，同时保留了 (C5)–(C6)，并在此较弱的设定下建立了块解耦的保证。 下一个问题是，当我们进一步转向实际的视觉状态估计，并额外放宽 (C5)–(C6) 时，由此产生的 CRL 原则是否仍然有效。 这构成了我们的经验性桥梁。

sents.en: The theoretical bridge in Section 3 already relaxes assumptions (C1)–(C4), while retaining (C5)–(C6), and establishes block-disentanglement guarantees under this weaker setting.
sents.zh: 第 3 节中的理论性桥梁已经放宽了假设 (C1)–(C4)，同时保留了 (C5)–(C6)，并在此较弱的设定下建立了块解耦的保证。

sents.en: The next question is whether the resulting CRL principles remain effective when we move further toward practical visual state estimation and additionally relax (C5)–(C6).
sents.zh: 下一个问题是，当我们进一步转向实际的视觉状态估计，并额外放宽 (C5)–(C6) 时，由此产生的 CRL 原则是否仍然有效。

sents.en: This constitutes our empirical bridge .
sents.zh: 这构成了我们的经验性桥梁。

paragraphs.en: To evaluate this progression, we consider two complementary empirical settings. The first, which we call the assumption-matched benchmark , satisfies the full set of assumptions (C1)–(C6). It provides a reference point for the performance attainable when the canonical CRL conditions hold, and allows us to assess the overall effectiveness of the methodology in its most favorable identifiable setting. The second, which we call the embodied setting , additionally dispenses with (C5)–(C6), on top of the relaxation of (C1)–(C4) already established by the block-disentanglement theory. Comparing these two settings therefore serves two complementary purposes: benchmarking performance under the canonical assumptions, and assessing how far the combined theoretical and empirical bridges can carry CRL toward visual state estimation under substantially weaker conditions.
paragraphs.zh: 为了评估这一进展，我们考虑了两种互补的经验性设定。 第一种设定我们称之为“假设匹配基准”，它满足完整的假设集合 (C1)–(C6)。 它为经典 CRL 条件成立时可达到的性能提供了一个参考点，并使我们能够评估该方法在其最有利且可识别的设定中的整体有效性。 第二种设定我们称之为“具身设定”，它在块解耦理论已确立的 (C1)–(C4) 放宽基础上，进一步取消了 (C5)–(C6)。 因此，比较这两种设定具有两个互补的目的：在经典假设下对性能进行基准测试，以及评估结合理论与经验的桥梁能在多大程度上推动 CRL 在显著较弱的条件下实现视觉状态估计。

paragraphs.en: We consider estimating a robot’s pose and joint configuration from visual observations as an important instance of visual state estimation. This capability is particularly relevant when a robot’s internal state is unavailable, unreliable, or cannot be directly communicated to other agents. Accordingly, visual recovery of articulated robot state has received growing attention in computer vision and robotics. We refer to Appendix A for a thorough review of the related literature.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将通过视觉观测估计机器人的姿态和关节构型视为视觉状态估计的一个重要实例。 当机器人的内部状态不可用、不可靠，或无法直接与其他智能体通信时，这种能力尤为重要。 因此，在计算机视觉和机器人领域，对串联机器人状态的视觉恢复方法日益受到关注。 相关文献的详尽综述请参见附录 A。

paragraphs.en: For our study, the latent physical state of interest is the robot arm’s joint configuration. The rendered images depend on these joint angles, as well as other intrinsic and extrinsic factors such as link geometry, camera pose, lighting, and background. To isolate the state estimation problem, we vary only the joint angles while holding the remaining generative factors fixed. We generate the visual observations using the Panda-Gym platform ( Gallouédec et al., 2021 ) , which provides controlled actuation of the robotic arm and corresponding rendered images. To preserve observability of the full joint configuration and support the injective rendering assumption on f f , we record each pose from two distinct camera viewpoints.
paragraphs.zh: 在我们的研究中，所关注的潜在物理状态是机器人手臂的关节构型。 渲染出的图像取决于这些关节角度，以及其他内在和外在因素，例如连杆几何形状、相机姿态、光照和背景。 为了将状态估计问题单独分离出来，我们仅改变关节角度，同时保持其余生成因素不变。 我们使用 Panda-Gym 平台（Gallouédec 等人，2021）生成视觉观测数据，该平台可提供对机器人手臂的受控驱动以及相应的渲染图像。 为了保持完整关节构型的可观测性，并支持对 f f 的单射渲染假设，我们从两个不同的相机视角记录每种姿态。

paragraphs.en: As briefly mentioned earlier, in our analysis we consider the following empirical regimes.
paragraphs.zh: 如前文简要提及的，在我们的分析中，我们考虑了以下经验性机制。

paragraphs.en: Assumption-matched benchmark. This setting satisfies (C1)–(C6). Interventions are atomic (C1), replacing one joint’s sampling distribution with a hard intervention while leaving the others untouched (C2); environments come in matched pairs ( q i , q ¯ i ) (q^{i},\bar{q}^{i}) per joint as (C3) requires, and are designed to satisfy (C4); joint angles are sampled i.i.d. and rendered independently, so there is no temporal structure (C5); and the true number of varying joints is known (C6). This regime validates whether disentanglement and variable estimation are numerically stable on rendered 128 × 128 128\times 128 images, and whether the canonical objective recovers the intended coordinates at this visual scale.

sents.zh: 干预是原子的 (C1)，即用硬性干预替换一个关节的采样分布，同时保持其他关节不变 (C2)；环境按每个关节成匹配对出现 ( q i , q ¯ i ) (q^{i},\bar{q}^{i})，如 (C3) 所要求，并被设计为满足 (C4)；关节角度是独立同分布地采样并独立渲染的，因此不存在时间结构 (C5)；并且已知实际变化的关节数量 (C6)。

sents.en: This regime validates whether disentanglement and variable estimation are numerically stable on rendered 128 × 128 128\times 128 images, and whether the canonical objective recovers the intended coordinates at this visual scale.
sents.zh: 该机制验证了分离和变量估计在渲染出的 128 × 128 图像上是否在数值上稳定，以及标准目标函数是否在此视觉尺度下能恢复预期的坐标。

paragraphs.en: Embodied setting. This setting moves beyond the conditions of Theorem 1 and additionally violates (C5)–(C6). Specifically, it replaces i.i.d. rendering with continuous videos. A proportional controller drives the arm from a sampled start to a sampled goal configuration, and it retains every frame along the way. Episodes terminate and reset, limiting dependence across trajectories but not within one. Each environment k k corresponds to a distinct goal-sampling distribution that prioritizes displacement of a designated target joint while letting the remaining joints move as the dynamics dictate. Importantly, no observational dataset is distinguished. These departures from the theoretical setting arise through three distinct mechanisms: temporal dependence in the observed data, imperfect and coupled intervention effects, and mismatch between the learned bottleneck dimension and the true latent dimension. We summarize each violation below and indicate the corresponding theoretical assumption that it relaxes.
paragraphs.zh: 具身设定。 该设定超越了定理 1 的条件，并进一步违反了 (C5)–(C6)。 具体而言，它将独立同分布的渲染替换为连续视频。 一个比例控制器将机械臂从采样起点驱动至采样目标构型，并保留沿途的每一帧。 回合结束并重置，这限制了不同轨迹之间的依赖关系，但未限制同一轨迹内的依赖。 每个环境 k 都对应一个独特的目标采样分布，该分布优先移动指定目标关节，同时允许其余关节按照动力学规律运动。 重要的是，没有区分任何观测数据集。 这些与理论设定的偏离通过三种不同机制产生：观测数据中的时间依赖性、不完美的耦合干预效应，以及学习到的瓶颈维度与真实潜在维度之间的不匹配。 我们在下文中总结了每一项违反情况，并指出了其所放宽的相应理论假设。

paragraphs.en: V1: Temporal dependence (violates C5). Consecutive frames differ by one controller step. Therefore, samples within a video are strongly correlated. We in fact leverage the controlled nature of the videos to compute score differences without an observational environment by treating the two halves of each video as observational and interventional data.
paragraphs.zh: V1：时间依赖性（违反 C5）。 连续帧之间仅相差一个控制器步骤。 因此，视频内的样本之间存在强相关性。 实际上，我们利用视频的受控特性，将每个视频的两半分别视为观察数据和干预数据，从而无需观测环境即可计算分数差异。

paragraphs.en: In the assumption-matched benchmark introduced above, where assumptions (C1)–(C6) are all satisfied, Varıcı et al. (2025, Theorem 22) shows that elementwise disentanglement can be achieved by learning an encoder–decoder pair that minimizes a score-based regularization objective together with a reconstruction loss. Specifically, in this setting, we consider score differences between the interventional pair of environments ( q i , q ¯ i ) (q^{i},\bar{q}^{i}) affecting each node i i , which we denote by d i d^{i} . The objective penalizes deviations from the expected structure of score differences across interventional environments, while the reconstruction term ensures that the learned representation preserves the observed data. Under the stated assumptions, minimizing this objective guarantees elementwise disentanglement of the latent variables:
paragraphs.zh: 在上文介绍的假设匹配基准中，当假设 (C1)–(C6) 均得到满足时，Varıcı 等人 (2025, 定理 22) 指出，通过学习一个编码器-解码器对，该对同时最小化基于分数的正则化目标函数和重建损失，即可实现逐元素解耦。 具体而言，在此设定中，我们考虑干预环境对 ( q i , q ¯ i ) (q^{i},\bar{q}^{i}) 对每个节点 i i 产生的分数差异，并将其表示为 d i d^{i}。 该目标函数会惩罚分数差异在干预环境间偏离预期结构的程度，而重建项则确保所学到的表示能够保留观测数据。 在上述假设条件下，最小化该目标函数可保证潜在变量的逐元素解耦：

paragraphs.en: The implementation consists of three stages, summarized in Figure 1 . The input consists of high-dimensional visual observations X X collected under different interventional environments, and the objective is to obtain a low-dimensional estimate Z ^ \smash{\hat{Z}} of the physical state.
paragraphs.zh: 该实现包含三个阶段，如图 1 所示。 输入包括在不同干预环境下收集的高维视觉观测数据 X，其目标是获得物理状态的低维估计值 Z ^ \smash{\hat{Z}}。

sents.en: The implementation consists of three stages, summarized in Figure 1 .

sents.en: The input consists of high-dimensional visual observations X X collected under different interventional environments, and the objective is to obtain a low-dimensional estimate Z ^ \smash{\hat{Z}} of the physical state.

paragraphs.en: Stage 1 (AE1) performs dimensionality reduction. Directly estimating score functions and score differences in the image domain is computationally expensive. We therefore use a convolutional autoencoder ( E 1 , D 1 ) (E_{1},D_{1}) to map each grayscale image X X to a lower-dimensional 8 × 8 × 1 8\times 8\times 1 feature representation Y = E 1 ​ ( X ) Y=E_{1}(X) by minimizing the reconstruction loss 𝔼 X ​ [ ‖ X − D 1 ​ ( E 1 ​ ( X ) ) ‖ 2 2 ] \smash{{\mathbb{E}}_{X}\![\|X-D_{1}(E_{1}(X))\|_{2}^{2}]} . After training, we freeze E 1 E_{1} and use it as a feature extractor. This compression substantially reduces the dimension in which we must estimate score differences, at the potential cost of discarding latent information. We therefore separately evaluate how much state information is retained by Y Y .
paragraphs.zh: 阶段 1（AE1）执行降维操作。 直接在图像域中估计得分函数和得分差异会耗费大量计算资源。 因此，我们使用一个卷积自编码器（E₁, D₁）将每张灰度图像 X 映射到一个更低维的 8×8×1 特征表示 Y=E₁(X)，通过最小化重建损失 𝔼ₓ[‖X−D₁(E₁(X))‖₂²] 来实现。 训练完成后，我们冻结 E₁，并将其用作特征提取器。 这种压缩显著降低了我们必须估计得分差异的维度，但潜在代价是可能丢弃部分潜在信息。 因此，我们单独评估了 Y 保留了多少状态信息。

paragraphs.en: Stage 2 (LDR) estimates intervention-induced score differences in the feature space. We exploit the fact that a binary classifier trained with cross-entropy loss estimates the log-density ratio between the two classes ( Gutmann and Hyvärinen, 2012 ) . For each interventional environment k k , we train a log-density-ratio estimator f LDR ( k ) {f_{\mathrm{LDR}}^{(k)}} to distinguish samples between chosen distributions. The gradient of its logit, ∇ y f LDR ( k ) ​ ( y ) {\nabla_{y}f_{\mathrm{LDR}}^{(k)}(y)} , then provides an estimate of the corresponding feature-space score difference.
paragraphs.zh: 阶段 2（LDR）估计特征空间中由干预引起的分数差异。 我们利用了这样一个事实：使用交叉熵损失训练的二元分类器可以估计两类之间的对数密度比（Gutmann 和 Hyvärinen，2012）。 对于每个干预环境 k，我们训练一个对数密度比估计器 f_LDR^(k) {f_{\mathrm{LDR}}^{(k)}}，以区分来自所选分布的样本。 其逻辑函数的梯度 ∇_y f_LDR^(k)(y) 随后提供了对应特征空间分数差异的估计值。

paragraphs.en: Can CRL recover physical state from visual observations without state labels? In the assumption-matched benchmark, we test whether the canonical score-based CRL objective can recover individual joint variables from high-dimensional images when its identifiability assumptions are satisfied, and compare its performance with supervised pose-estimation methods.
paragraphs.zh: CRL 能否在没有状态标签的情况下，从视觉观察中恢复物理状态？ 在假设匹配的基准测试中，我们检验当可识别性假设得到满足时，经典的基于分数的 CRL 目标函数是否能够从高维图像中恢复单个关节变量，并将其性能与有监督的姿势估计方法进行比较。

paragraphs.en: In order to answer the questions above, we specify appropriate metrics for both assumption-matched and embodied settings. In the assumption-matched setting, we consider Mean Squared Error (MSE) as our main metric. To account for the elementwise diffeomorphism ambiguity of the recovered variables, we calibrate each estimated component using an affine transformation fitted on a separate set of 1000 samples and report MSE on the held-out evaluation set.

paragraphs.en: The setting for this experiment satisfies (C1)–(C6), and we use canonical CRL techniques. We compare the performance of our approach against a recent supervised baseline, RoboPEPP ( Goswami et al., 2025 ) , in Table 1 . For extensive ablations and additional results, see Appendix D . RoboPEPP is among the few methods that can estimate pose when joint angles are unknown at test time (along with HPE ( Ban et al., 2024 ) and RoboPOSE ( Labbé et al., 2021 ) ), and reports stronger performance than these alternatives. RoboPEPP uses a two-stage training procedure. First, a self-supervised I-JEPA backbone ( Assran et al., 2023 ) is trained on the entire training dataset. In the second stage, a “JointNet” is trained to predict the six joint angles from the concatenated I-JEPA embeddings of the two camera views, using an L 2 L_{2} loss and ground-truth joint-angle labels. In contrast, our CRL approach requires no labeled state data for training.
paragraphs.zh: 本实验的设置满足 (C1)–(C6)，且我们使用了标准的 CRL 技术。 我们在表 1 中比较了我们的方法与近期一种监督式基线方法 RoboPEPP（Goswami 等人，2025）的性能。 关于详尽的消融实验和补充结果，请参见附录 D。 RoboPEPP 是少数能够在测试时关节角度未知情况下估计姿态的方法之一（与 HPE（Ban 等人，2024）和 RoboPOSE（Labbé 等人，2021）并列），且其性能优于这些替代方法。 RoboPEPP 采用两阶段训练流程。 首先，在完整的训练数据集上训练一个自监督的 I-JEPA 主干网络（Assran 等人，2023）。 在第二阶段中，使用 L₂ L_{2} 损失和真实关节角度标签，基于两个摄像头视角拼接后的 I-JEPA 嵌入向量训练一个“JointNet”以预测六个关节角度。 相比之下，我们的 CRL 方法在训练时不需要任何带标签的状态数据。

paragraphs.en: Importantly, our approach achieves performance comparable to RoboPEPP when RoboPEPP is trained using labels for 5% of the dataset (approximately 6.5K labeled poses, corresponding to 13K labeled images from two camera orientations). Thus, the active/nuisance contrast persists under substantial overparameterization, while the full representation continues to learn additional features that purely help reconstruction.

paragraphs.en: In summary, our main empirical observation is that the structural principles motivating CRL remain effective well beyond their validity regime. In the embodied setting, despite extensive violations of the theoretical conditions that underlie it, the block regularizer retains substantially more recoverable state information within the designated active coordinates than the unregularized baseline.

paragraphs.en: We have proposed a two-step path from CRL identifiability theory toward label-free visual state estimation. In this first step, we weaken canonical intervention assumptions and establish block-disentanglement guarantees, showing that an active group of causal variables can remain identifiable even when individual variables cannot be recovered separately. In the second step, we show that the resulting principle remains effective for retaining relevant information in embodied visual settings that further violate the theoretical assumptions. Empirically, score-based CRL recovers robot joint states from images without state labels in the assumption-matched setting, and the block-based objective continues to be informative about the relevant physical variables under temporal dependence, imperfect interventions, and overcomplete representations. These two components are complementary. The theory characterizes what remains identifiable under weaker assumptions, while the experiments assess whether those principles remain effective as CRL moves toward practical visual data. To further narrow the theory-practice gap and realize CRL’s important potential, a key next step is to extend the identifiability theory to settings with temporally dependent observations, approximate intervention effects, and unknown or overcomplete latent dimensionality.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了一条从 CRL 可识别性理论走向无标签视觉状态估计的双步路径。 在第一步中，我们放宽了经典干预假设，并建立了块解耦的保证，表明即使单个变量无法单独恢复，一组因果变量仍然可以保持可识别性。 在第二步中，我们证明了由此得出的原则在进一步违反理论假设的具身视觉场景中，依然能有效保留相关信息。 从经验上看，在假设匹配的设定下，基于得分的 CRL 能够从图像中恢复机器人关节状态而无需状态标签；而在时间依赖、不完全干预和过度完备表示的情况下，基于块的优化目标仍能提供有关相关物理变量的有效信息。 这两个组成部分是互补的。 该理论描述了在较弱的假设下哪些内容仍然可被识别，而实验则评估了当 CRL 向实际视觉数据靠拢时，这些原则是否依然有效。 为了进一步缩小理论与实践之间的差距，并实现 CRL 的重要潜力，一个关键的下一步是将可识别性理论扩展到包含时间依赖观测、近似干预效应以及未知或过度完备潜在维度的场景。

paragraphs.en: Without additional structure or distributional diversity, recovering latent variables from observations under an unknown nonlinear mixing function is generally impossible ( Hyvärinen and Pajunen, 1999 ; Locatello et al., 2019 ) . Causal representation learning (CRL) addresses this ambiguity by exploiting causal structure and changes across environments. A substantial literature establishes identifiability from interventions under different assumptions on the observation map, latent causal model, and intervention mechanisms ( Squires et al., 2023 ; Buchholz et al., 2023 ; Zhang et al., 2023 ; von Kügelgen et al., 2023 ; Varıcı et al., 2024 ; Varıcı et al., 2025 ; Acartürk et al., 2024 ; Ng et al., 2025 ; Lee et al., 2026 ) . Other approaches include counterfactual CRL ( von Kügelgen et al., 2021 ) , unified frameworks to analyze interventional CRL along with nonlinear ICA and perturbation models ( Yi et al., 2026 ) , and temporal ( Lippe et al., 2023b ) and multi-view CRL literature ( Yao et al., 2025 ) . These results range from linear latent representations or observation models to general nonlinear transformations, and consider settings including hard, soft, known, and unknown interventions.
paragraphs.zh: 如果没有额外的结构或分布多样性，在未知非线性混合函数下从观测数据中恢复潜在变量通常是不可行的（Hyvärinen 和 Pajunen，1999；Locatello 等，2019）。 因果表示学习（CRL）通过利用因果结构以及跨环境的变化来解决这种模糊性。 大量文献已经确立了在不同假设下通过干预实现可识别性的方法，这些假设涉及观测映射、潜在因果模型和干预机制（Squires 等，2023；Buchholz 等，2023；Zhang 等，2023；von Kügelgen 等，2023；Varıcı 等，2024；Varıcı 等，2025；Acartürk 等，2024；Ng 等，2025；Lee 等，2026）。 其他方法包括反事实因果表示学习（von Kügelgen 等，2021）、用于分析干预性因果表示学习与非线性独立成分分析和扰动模型的统一框架（Yi 等，2026），以及时间序列（Lippe 等，2023b）和多视角因果表示学习的相关文献（Yao 等，2025）。 这些研究结果涵盖了从线性潜在表示或观测模型到一般非线性变换的各种情况，并考虑了硬性、软性、已知和未知干预等不同设定。

sents.en: Without additional structure or distributional diversity, recovering latent variables from observations under an unknown nonlinear mixing function is generally impossible ( Hyvärinen and Pajunen, 1999 ; Locatello et al., 2019 ) .

sents.en: Causal representation learning (CRL) addresses this ambiguity by exploiting causal structure and changes across environments.

paragraphs.en: Interventional diversity is particularly relevant to our work. Existing nonlinear CRL guarantees commonly obtain elementwise disentanglement by exploiting sufficiently localized and diverse changes across interventional environments ( von Kügelgen et al., 2023 ; Varıcı et al., 2025 ) or the nonlinear ICA connection under Gaussian additive noise models ( Ng et al., 2025 ) . Our result instead asks what remains identifiable when such intervention structure is unavailable, replacing intervention-by-intervention requirements with collective conditions on the support and span of score differences. The precise comparison between these assumptions and our conditions is given in Section 3 .
paragraphs.zh: 干预多样性与我们的工作尤其相关。 现有的非线性 CRL 保证通常通过利用干预环境中足够局部化和多样化的变化（von Kügelgen 等，2023；Varıcı 等，2025），或在高斯加性噪声模型下的非线性 ICA 联系（Ng 等，2025）来实现逐元素的解纠缠。 我们的结果则探讨了当此类干预结构不可用时，哪些内容仍然可以被识别，从而将逐次干预的要求替换为对得分差异支撑集和跨度集合性的条件。 这些假设与我们条件之间的精确比较在第 3 节中给出。

For general nonlinear transformation, Liang et al. (2023) identify intervention-target blocks when the causal graph and target sets are known and sufficiently diverse perfect interventions satisfy a block score-rank condition. Ahuja et al. (2024) use ancestrally closed soft intervention target sets (with proper distributional assumptions) to disentangle the non-intervened variables from the intervened ones. Yao et al. (2025) establish a broader invariant-block identification result by combining information preservation with an invariance condition. Our Theorem 1 establishes recovery of the intervention-affected block through collective score diversity, even when its individual coordinates cannot be separated. The discussion following the theorem compares the required intervention structure and diversity conditions with these earlier guarantees.

paragraphs.en: Visual robot pose estimation is most commonly formulated as a supervised prediction problem. DREAM ( Lee et al., 2020 ) estimates robot pose through image-space keypoints, while RoboPose ( Labbé et al., 2021 ) iteratively refines pose and joint-angle estimates. More recent methods include HPE ( Ban et al., 2024 ) and RoboPEPP ( Goswami et al., 2025 ) , the latter combining self-supervised visual pretraining with supervised joint-angle regression. These methods demonstrate strong pose-estimation performance, but ultimately rely on pose or joint-state supervision for the prediction task. In contrast, our objective is to recover the underlying physical state representation without per-frame state labels, using variation across intervention environments as the learning signal.
paragraphs.zh: 视觉机器人姿态估计通常被表述为一个有监督的预测问题。 DREAM（Lee 等人，2020）通过图像空间的关键点来估计机器人姿态，而 RoboPose（Labbé 等人，2021）则迭代地优化姿态和关节角度的估计值。 更近期的方法包括 HPE（Ban 等人，2024）和 RoboPEPP（Goswami 等人，2025），后者将自监督的视觉预训练与有监督的关节角度回归相结合。 这些方法展现了强大的姿态估计性能，但最终仍依赖姿态或关节状态的监督来完成预测任务。 相比之下，我们的目标是在没有逐帧状态标签的情况下，利用不同干预环境之间的差异作为学习信号，来恢复底层的物理状态表示。

paragraphs.en: Classical alternatives include geometry- and marker-based systems, such as fiducial-marker approaches ( Garrido-Jurado et al., 2014 ; García-Ruiz et al., 2023 ) . These methods provide a different tradeoff, relying on known geometric structure, calibration, or instrumentation rather than learned latent representations. Our experiments are not intended to replace these specialized pose-estimation pipelines; rather, robot pose provides a controlled embodied setting in which to study whether identifiable-CRL principles can be carried from high-dimensional observations toward state estimation under progressively weaker assumptions.
paragraphs.zh: 传统的替代方案包括基于几何和标记的系统，例如基准标记方法（Garrido-Jurado 等人，2014；García-Ruiz 等人，2023）。 这些方法提供了不同的权衡，它们依赖已知的几何结构、校准或设备，而非通过学习获得的潜在表示。 我们的实验并非旨在取代这些专门化的姿态估计流程；相反，机器人姿态提供了一个受控的具身环境，用于研究可识别的 CRL 原则是否可以从高维观测中迁移到在逐步削弱的假设下进行的狀態估计。

paragraphs.en: We list the main limitations of our paper.
paragraphs.zh: 我们列出了本文的主要局限性。

paragraphs.en: Our empirical analysis is limited to simulation studies in a controlled environment. This is a deliberate choice to maximize controllability of the experimental setting. However, in order to demonstrate practicality, CRL field needs to start using real-world data as well. This paper shows that such a transition does not have to be done abruptly.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的实证分析仅限于在受控环境中的模拟研究。 这是为了最大限度地控制实验设置而做出的有意选择。 然而，为了证明其实用性，CRL领域也需要开始使用真实世界的数据。 本文表明，这种转变并不一定需要突然进行。

paragraphs.en: Proving robust estimation for both score estimation and disentanglement stages against using non-i.i.d. data would address violation V1 (temporal dependence) directly, and are likely a prerequisite for any theoretical treatment of video modality from the interventional CRL perspective.

paragraphs.en: An approximate version of Theorem 1 that bounds the degradation of block recovery in terms of the magnitude of off-block score deviations would be required to treat violation V2 (off-target effects) from a theoretically grounded perspective.

paragraphs.en: Ground-truth joint angles are not used to train AE1, the LDR estimators, or AE2. They are used only for evaluation through the R 2 R^{2} metrics defined in Equation 11 . All results and training curves reported in this section correspond to a single fixed random seed and to the final training iterate.
paragraphs.zh: 真实关节角度并未用于训练 AE1、LDR 估计器或 AE2。 它们仅通过公式 11 中定义的 R² 指标用于评估。 本节报告的所有结果和训练曲线均对应于一个固定的随机种子以及最终的训练迭代。

sents.en: Ground-truth joint angles are not used to train AE1, the LDR estimators, or AE2.
sents.zh: 真实关节角度并未用于训练 AE1、LDR 估计器或 AE2。

sents.en: They are used only for evaluation through the R 2 R^{2} metrics defined in Equation 11 .
sents.zh: 它们仅通过公式 11 中定义的 R² 指标用于评估。

sents.en: All results and training curves reported in this section correspond to a single fixed random seed and to the final training iterate.
sents.zh: 本节报告的所有结果和训练曲线均对应于一个固定的随机种子以及最终的训练迭代。

paragraphs.en: Data collection replaces i.i.d. rendering with continuous trajectories. We construct six environments, one for each robot joint. Each environment is generated from 4000 closed-loop trajectories and differs through the goal-sampling distribution used for its nominally targeted joint.
paragraphs.zh: 数据收集用连续轨迹取代了独立同分布的渲染方式。 我们构建了六个环境，每个环境对应一个机器人关节。 每个环境都由 4000 条闭环轨迹生成，并通过为其名义目标关节使用的目标采样分布而有所差异。

sents.en: Data collection replaces i.i.d. rendering with continuous trajectories.
sents.zh: 数据收集用连续轨迹取代了独立同分布的渲染方式。

sents.en: We construct six environments, one for each robot joint.
sents.zh: 我们构建了六个环境，每个环境对应一个机器人关节。

sents.en: Each environment is generated from 4000 closed-loop trajectories and differs through the goal-sampling distribution used for its nominally targeted joint.
sents.zh: 每个环境都由 4000 条闭环轨迹生成，并通过为其名义目标关节使用的目标采样分布而有所差异。

paragraphs.en: Sample a start configuration and a goal configuration. In environment k k , the goal distribution prioritizes displacement of joint k k (sampled uniformly at random with minimum displacement of 0.5 0.5 radians), while the remaining joint targets are changed in a small amount (shifted by a uniformly random value less than 0.05 0.05 radians).
paragraphs.zh: 采样一个初始配置和一个目标配置。 在环境 k k 中，目标分布优先调整关节 k k（以均匀随机方式采样，最小位移为 0.5 0.5 弧度），而其他关节的目标则仅作微小调整（偏移量为一个小于 0.05 0.05 弧度的均匀随机值）。

sents.en: Sample a start configuration and a goal configuration.
sents.zh: 采样一个初始配置和一个目标配置。

sents.en: In environment k k , the goal distribution prioritizes displacement of joint k k (sampled uniformly at random with minimum displacement of 0.5 0.5 radians), while the remaining joint targets are changed in a small amount (shifted by a uniformly random value less than 0.05 0.05 radians).
sents.zh: 在环境 k k 中，目标分布优先调整关节 k k（以均匀随机方式采样，最小位移为 0.5 0.5 弧度），而其他关节的目标则仅作微小调整（偏移量为一个小于 0.05 0.05 弧度的均匀随机值）。

paragraphs.en: Drive the arm from its start configuration toward the sampled goal using a proportional controller. Every simulator step is rendered and retained, so consecutive observations differ by one controller step.
paragraphs.zh: 使用比例控制器，将机械臂从其初始构型驱动至采样得到的目标位置。 每个模拟步骤都会被渲染并保留，因此连续的观察结果仅相差一个控制器的步骤。

sents.en: Drive the arm from its start configuration toward the sampled goal using a proportional controller.
sents.zh: 使用比例控制器，将机械臂从其初始构型驱动至采样得到的目标位置。

sents.en: Every simulator step is rendered and retained, so consecutive observations differ by one controller step.
sents.zh: 每个模拟步骤都会被渲染并保留，因此连续的观察结果仅相差一个控制器的步骤。

paragraphs.en: Terminate the trajectory once the goal is reached within a prescribed tolerance or after a fixed step budget (max. 40 frames), and reset the environment before generating the next trajectory.
paragraphs.zh: 一旦目标在规定的容差范围内达成，或在固定的步数预算（最多 40 帧）结束后，即终止轨迹，并在生成下一个轨迹之前重置环境。

paragraphs.en: We use the same two-camera rendering configuration: one at 45 and other 135 degrees with respect to the arm’s natural position, with observations from the two views concatenated after AE1 feature extraction.
paragraphs.zh: 我们采用相同的两摄像头渲染配置：一个摄像头与手臂的自然位置呈 45 度角，另一个呈 135 度角，在 AE1 特征提取后，将两个视角的观察结果进行拼接。

paragraphs.en: Start states are sampled uniformly at random from the valid angles. The simulator itself rejects malformed configurations (e.g., where the robot arm intersects the table), so no additional processing during generation were needed.
paragraphs.zh: 初始状态从有效角度中均匀随机采样。 模拟器本身会拒绝格式错误的配置（例如，机器人手臂与桌子相交的情况），因此生成过程中无需进行额外处理。

sents.en: Start states are sampled uniformly at random from the valid angles.
sents.zh: 初始状态从有效角度中均匀随机采样。

sents.en: The simulator itself rejects malformed configurations (e.g., where the robot arm intersects the table), so no additional processing during generation were needed.
sents.zh: 模拟器本身会拒绝格式错误的配置（例如，机器人手臂与桌子相交的情况），因此生成过程中无需进行额外处理。

paragraphs.en: The target distribution at the default configuration (the default “embodied regime” setup) is chosen such that in environment k k , the k k -th joint angle is set to be significantly different (difference ≥ 0.5 \geq 0.5 radians) from the initial state. The off-target joints are instead targeted with relatively smaller perturbations ( < 0.05 <0.05 radians).
paragraphs.zh: 默认配置（即默认的“具身机制”设置）下的目标分布被这样选择：在环境 k 中，第 k 个关节角被设定为与初始状态显著不同（差异 ≥ 0.5 弧度）。 而非目标关节则通过相对较小的扰动（< 0.05 弧度）进行调节。

sents.en: The target distribution at the default configuration (the default “embodied regime” setup) is chosen such that in environment k k , the k k -th joint angle is set to be significantly different (difference ≥ 0.5 \geq 0.5 radians) from the initial state.
sents.zh: 默认配置（即默认的“具身机制”设置）下的目标分布被这样选择：在环境 k 中，第 k 个关节角被设定为与初始状态显著不同（差异 ≥ 0.5 弧度）。

sents.en: The off-target joints are instead targeted with relatively smaller perturbations ( < 0.05 <0.05 radians).
sents.zh: 而非目标关节则通过相对较小的扰动（< 0.05 弧度）进行调节。

paragraphs.en: The proportional controller gain is set to 1 1 ; however, the trajectories were stable and smooth across the configuration space. Maximum trajectory length was set at 40 40 frames.
paragraphs.zh: 比例控制器增益设为 1 1；不过，轨迹在整个构型空间中保持稳定且平滑。 最大轨迹长度设为 40 40 帧。

sents.en: The proportional controller gain is set to 1 1 ; however, the trajectories were stable and smooth across the configuration space.
sents.zh: 比例控制器增益设为 1 1；不过，轨迹在整个构型空间中保持稳定且平滑。

sents.en: Maximum trajectory length was set at 40 40 frames.
sents.zh: 最大轨迹长度设为 40 40 帧。

paragraphs.en: The resulting data exhibit strong temporal dependence within each trajectory. Resets limit dependence across episodes but do not remove the correlation between consecutive frames within one episode. Moreover, targeting one joint does not yield an atomic intervention in the resulting trajectory: closed-loop motion generally induces simultaneous motion of other joints. Thus, the environment label indicates the joint whose displacement is emphasized rather than an intervention that changes only a single latent coordinate.
paragraphs.zh: 生成的数据在每个轨迹内部都表现出强烈的时间依赖性。 重置会限制不同回合之间的依赖性，但不会消除单个回合内连续帧之间的相关性。 此外，针对一个关节进行操作并不会在生成的轨迹中产生原子级的干预：闭环运动通常会引发其他关节的同步运动。 因此，环境标签表示的是其位移被强调的关节，而不是仅改变单个潜在坐标的干预。

sents.en: The resulting data exhibit strong temporal dependence within each trajectory.
sents.zh: 生成的数据在每个轨迹内部都表现出强烈的时间依赖性。

sents.en: Resets limit dependence across episodes but do not remove the correlation between consecutive frames within one episode.
sents.zh: 重置会限制不同回合之间的依赖性，但不会消除单个回合内连续帧之间的相关性。

sents.en: Moreover, targeting one joint does not yield an atomic intervention in the resulting trajectory: closed-loop motion generally induces simultaneous motion of other joints.
sents.zh: 此外，针对一个关节进行操作并不会在生成的轨迹中产生原子级的干预：闭环运动通常会引发其他关节的同步运动。

sents.en: Thus, the environment label indicates the joint whose displacement is emphasized rather than an intervention that changes only a single latent coordinate.
sents.zh: 因此，环境标签表示的是其位移被强调的关节，而不是仅改变单个潜在坐标的干预。

paragraphs.en: In the finalized experiments we use all six environments jointly, so ℐ = [ n ] \mathcal{I}=[n] . Consequently, off-target motion makes the individual environments non-atomic and couples their intervention effects.
paragraphs.zh: 在最终确定的实验中，我们联合使用全部六个环境，因此 ℐ = [ n ] \mathcal{I}=[n]。 因此，偏离目标的动作会使各个环境失去原子性，并使其干预效应相互耦合。

sents.en: In the finalized experiments we use all six environments jointly, so ℐ = [ n ] \mathcal{I}=[n] .
sents.zh: 在最终确定的实验中，我们联合使用全部六个环境，因此 ℐ = [ n ] \mathcal{I}=[n]。

sents.en: Consequently, off-target motion makes the individual environments non-atomic and couples their intervention effects.
sents.zh: 因此，偏离目标的动作会使各个环境失去原子性，并使其干预效应相互耦合。

paragraphs.en: Unlike the assumption-matched setting, the embodied regime does not contain a separately generated observational dataset. Instead, we exploit the directional structure of each controlled trajectory to construct the two distributions required by the log-density-ratio estimator.
paragraphs.zh: 与假设匹配的设置不同，具身机制并不包含一个单独生成的观测数据集。 相反，我们利用每条受控轨迹的方向性结构来构建对数密度比估计器所需的两种分布。

sents.en: Unlike the assumption-matched setting, the embodied regime does not contain a separately generated observational dataset.
sents.zh: 与假设匹配的设置不同，具身机制并不包含一个单独生成的观测数据集。

sents.en: Instead, we exploit the directional structure of each controlled trajectory to construct the two distributions required by the log-density-ratio estimator.
sents.zh: 相反，我们利用每条受控轨迹的方向性结构来构建对数密度比估计器所需的两种分布。

paragraphs.en: For every trajectory in environment k k , we divide the sequence into two non-overlapping temporal halves. paragraphs.en: In the embodied setting, this temporal-half contrast is an empirical proxy motivated by the theoretical score-difference construction, rather than a direct estimate of the interventional score difference in Theorem 1 .

paragraphs.en: We deliberately use non-overlapping temporal halves rather than frame-by-frame contrasts between nearby portions of the same trajectory. At finite sample size, heavily overlapping temporal supports would cause the classifier to observe nearly indistinguishable samples from the two classes over much of the trajectory, thus substantially weakening the density-ratio signal. The half-trajectory construction instead provides a coarser but more separable contrast while retaining the continuous-video nature of the data.
paragraphs.zh: 我们刻意使用不重叠的时间段，而不是对同一轨迹中相邻部分的逐帧对比。 在有限样本量下，高度重叠的时间支持会导致分类器在轨迹的大部分区域观察到两个类别中几乎无法区分的样本，从而显著削弱密度比信号。 相比之下，半轨迹构造提供了一种更粗略但更具可分性的对比方式，同时保留了数据的连续视频特性。

paragraphs.en: The results show that the multi-target setting is almost indistinguishable from the single-dominant-target regime. paragraphs.en: Overall, the finalized sweeps support the same qualitative conclusion as the main embodied results: the score-based block regularizer concentrates substantially more recoverable state information into the designated coordinates than reconstruction alone, while the result remains relatively insensitive to substantial overparameterization of the learned representation.
paragraphs.zh: 总体而言，最终完成的扫描结果与主要的具身化实验结果得出了相同的定性结论：基于分数的块正则化器比单纯的重建方法能将更多可恢复的状态信息集中到指定的坐标中，同时该结果对所学表示的大幅过参数化仍然相对不敏感。

paragraphs.en: In this section, we additionally report a standard metric in elementwise CRL: Mean Correlation Coefficient (MCC) ( Khemakhem et al., 2020 ) . Furthermore, MSE requires the estimated latent variable estimates to be compared against the ground-truth values. In order to do so, we first calibrate the estimates using a held-out set of 1000 labelled samples using elementwise affine regression.

paragraphs.en: Our inference process is unsupervised, meaning we do not require pose-labeled images. The data needed for inference are generated via interventions, which are applied by manipulating the joints individually and capturing the resulting images. Following Section 4.2 , for each joint variable Z i Z_{i} , we have one observational and two interventional distributions, p p , q i q_{i} , and q ¯ i \bar{q}_{i} . Our learning algorithm is oblivious to any metadata or statistics associated with these distributions and learns from a random collection of poses generated before and after interventions. We denote the images drawn from q i q_{i} and q ¯ i \bar{q}_{i} by ‘0’ and ‘1’ respectively. Details of these distributions are described next, and exact parameterizations are given in Section D.1.1 .

paragraphs.en: We generate our dataset using a Franka Emika Panda arm in a Panda-Gym simulator ( Gallouédec et al., 2021 ) . The arm has six primary joint angles, which are marked in Figure 7 . Our data generation process consists of two stages. First, we focus on a setup with a single camera, generating interventions for the joints whose movements are confined to the camera’s plane, i.e., the 2D projection plane, perpendicular to the camera’s viewing direction. In the second stage, to accommodate the out-of-plane motions from other joints, which cannot be captured from a single viewpoint, we expand the dataset using images generated by two camera angles. The images in the dataset are converted to grayscale, resulting in a shape of 128 × 128 × 1 128\times 128\times 1 for each image.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 Panda-Gym 模拟器中的 Franka Emika Panda 机械臂来生成数据集（Gallouédec 等人，2021）。 该机械臂有六个主要关节角度，如图 7 所示。 我们的数据生成过程分为两个阶段。 首先，我们专注于单摄像头设置，为那些运动局限于摄像头平面（即与摄像头观察方向垂直的二维投影平面）的关节生成干预数据。 在第二阶段，为了容纳其他关节产生的平面外运动（这些运动无法通过单一视角捕捉），我们使用由两个摄像头角度生成的图像来扩展数据集。 数据集中的图像被转换为灰度图，因此每张图像的维度为 128 × 128 × 1。

paragraphs.en: Data on In-Plane Joints using a Single Camera. We first focus on joints 2, 4, and 6, as their movement primarily results in motion within the camera’s plane, and a single camera view is sufficient to cover the plane. Each data point in this dataset consists of a set of six interventional images (two for each joint) anchored by a single observational state. This observational state is generated by sampling a configuration for all six joints from a base truncated normal distribution. From this anchor, we create two distinct “hard interventions” for each of the target joints (2, 4, and 6). To perform an intervention on a specific joint, its angle is resampled from a distribution with a mean shifted far from the observational mean, while all other joint angles are held constant. This results in one observational image and six interventional images per data point.
paragraphs.zh: 使用单台摄像头获取的平面内关节数据。 我们首先关注关节 2、4 和 6，因为它们的运动主要发生在摄像头的平面内，而单台摄像头的视角足以覆盖该平面。 该数据集的每个数据点都包含一组六张干预图像（每个关节两张），并以一个观测状态作为锚定。 该观测状态是通过从一个基础截断正态分布中为全部六个关节采样配置生成的。 基于这个锚点，我们为每个目标关节（2、4 和 6）生成两种不同的“硬性干预”。 要对某个特定关节进行干预，需从其角度分布中重新采样，该分布的均值被大幅偏离观测均值，而其他所有关节的角度则保持不变。 这样，每个数据点就包含一张观测图像和六张干预图像。

paragraphs.en: Data on All Joints using Two Cameras. To extend our analysis to all six degrees of freedom, we also need to consider joints 1, 3, and 5, whose actuation causes significant out-of-plane motion. To ensure full observability, we captured every pose from two distinct camera angles ( 45 ∘ 45^{\circ} and 135 ∘ 135^{\circ} yaw). We augment the dataset such that each data point now begins with an observational pose captured from both cameras (2 images). Subsequently, we perform two hard interventions on each of the six joints ( j ∈ { 1 , … , 6 } j\in\{1,\dots,6\} ). Each of these 12 interventional pose distributions is captured by both camera angles. Thus, a single complete data point in this extended dataset consists of 26 images: 2 observational images plus 24 interventional images (6 joints × \times 2 interventions/joint × \times 2 cameras/pose).
paragraphs.zh: 使用两台相机获取所有关节的数据。 为了将我们的分析扩展到全部六个自由度，我们还需要考虑关节 1、3 和 5，它们的驱动会引起显著的平面外运动。 为确保完全可观测性，我们从两个不同的相机角度（45° 和 135° 偏航角）捕捉了每个姿态。 我们对数据集进行了扩展，使得每个数据点现在都以从两台相机捕捉到的观测姿态（2 张图像）开头。 随后，我们对六个关节中的每一个（j ∈ {1, …, 6}）执行两次强干预。 这 12 种干预姿态分布的每一种都由两个相机角度共同捕捉。 因此，这个扩展数据集中的单个完整数据点由 26 张图像组成：2 张观测图像加上 24 张干预图像（6 个关节 × 每个关节 2 次干预 × 每个姿态 2 台相机）。

paragraphs.en: All models were trained on TPUs. We performed a hyperparameter search for the optimal learning rate, testing values in the range of 10 − 7 10^{-7} to 10 − 3 10^{-3} . Our dataset consists of 10,000 observational images. We generated corresponding interventional images for two experimental setups: In the single-camera setup, each observational image yields 6 interventional images. In the two-camera setup, each observational image yields 24 interventional images. The training process involved three stages. First, Autoencoder-1 was trained on 70k images (single-camera) and 260k images (two-camera) with a batch size of 256. Second, we trained a separate binary classifier network (i.e., the log-ratio density estimator) for each joint, using 20k samples (single-camera) and 40k samples (two-camera) with a batch size of 64. Finally, for each joint, we trained a corresponding Autoencoder-2 alongside its specific LDR. Autoencoder-2 is trained on the same number of samples as Autoencoder-1 for both single camera and two camera setup.
paragraphs.zh: 所有模型均在 TPU 上训练。 我们对最优学习率进行了超参数搜索，测试范围从 10^{-7} 到 10^{-3}。 我们的数据集包含 10,000 张观测图像。 我们为两种实验设置生成了相应的干预图像：在单摄像头设置中，每张观测图像可生成 6 张干预图像。 在双摄像头设置中，每张观测图像可生成 24 张干预图像。 训练过程包含三个阶段。 首先，Autoencoder-1 在 70,000 张（单摄像头）和 260,000 张（双摄像头）图像上进行训练，批量大小为 256。 其次，我们为每个关节训练了一个独立的二元分类器网络（即对数比率密度估计器），使用 20,000 个样本（单摄像头）和 40,000 个样本（双摄像头），批量大小为 64。 最后，对于每个关节，我们训练了相应的 Autoencoder-2 及其特定的 LDR。 在单摄像头和双摄像头两种设置中，Autoencoder-2 的训练样本数量与 Autoencoder-1 相同。

paragraphs.en: We begin by evaluating the model in a single-camera setting, where joint angles are sampled independently according to the distributions specified in Table 3 . As this setup restricts visibility, we evaluate performance only on the three in-plane joints (2, 4, and 6) discussed in Section D.1 . Table 7 (first row) shows that MCC is consistently at least 0.94 0.94 . Remarkably, this disentanglement performance is stronger than that of the prior experiments in CRL studies in much simpler image datasets (e.g., see ( Varıcı et al., 2025 , Table 14) ). A qualitative analysis of the model’s reconstruction performance is provided in Figure 9 , presenting the scatter plots of the learned latent variables against the ground-truth angles.
paragraphs.zh: 我们首先在单摄像头设置下评估该模型，其中关节角度根据表 3 中指定的分布独立采样。 由于这种设置限制了可见性，我们仅在 D.1 节中讨论的三个平面内关节（第 2、4 和 6 个关节）上评估性能。 表 7（第一行）显示，MCC 始终至少为 0.94 0.94。 值得注意的是，这种解耦性能比 CRL 研究中在更简单的图像数据集上进行的先前实验更强（例如，参见 (Varıcı et al., 2025, 表 14)）。 图 9 提供了模型重建性能的定性分析，展示了所学习潜在变量与真实角度之间的散点图。

paragraphs.en: We extend our analysis to a more complex two-camera setup, which provides the multi-view information necessary to disentangle all six robot joints. The joint angles are again sampled independently (see Table 4 ). As shown in Table 7 (second row) and the scatter plots in Figure 10 , the model successfully disentangles all six joints. However, we observe a performance drop for joints 3 and 5 compared to the others. We attribute this performance discrepancy to less precise score estimates from the LDR network, an interpretation supported by the fact that these two joints exhibited a relatively larger classification loss during LDR training. This suggests that the images of the hard interventions for joints 3 and 5 are less distinct, making them inherently more challenging to classify. Notably, the MCC scores for joints 2, 4, and 6 remain robust when transitioning from the single-camera to the two-camera setup. The stability of these scores suggests that the score-based method scales effectively, leveraging the multi-view information. Reconstructed images from the AE1 and AE2 are shown in the Figure 20 .
paragraphs.zh: 我们将分析扩展到更复杂的双摄像头设置，该设置提供了分离全部六个机器人关节所需的多视角信息。 关节角度再次被独立采样（参见表4）。 如表7（第二行）和图10中的散点图所示，该模型成功分离了全部六个关节。 然而，与其余关节相比，我们观察到第3和第5关节的性能有所下降。 我们将这种性能差异归因于LDR网络得分估计的精度较低，这一解释也得到了以下事实的支持：在LDR训练期间，这两个关节的分类损失相对较大。 这表明，第3和第5关节困难干预的图像不够清晰，因此本质上更难进行分类。 值得注意的是，从单摄像头设置切换到双摄像头设置时，第2、4和6关节的MCC得分仍然保持稳定。 这些得分的稳定性表明，基于得分的方法能够有效地扩展，并利用多视角信息。 AE1和AE2的重建图像显示在图20中。

paragraphs.en: To assess whether our method can learn causal latents, which is the core premise of CRL, we generate a new dataset where joint angles are sampled according to a linear causal model described in Section D.1.2 . The structure and edge weights were chosen randomly, with joints 1, 2, and 4 set as root nodes. We report the results in Table 7 (third row). We observe that introducing a causal data generation process generally improves performance, with MSE values decreasing across most joints compared to the independent two-camera model. Overall, this experiment demonstrates the flexibility of the score-based approach to accommodate causal interactions among the joints.
paragraphs.zh: 为了评估我们的方法是否能够学习因果潜在变量——这也是 CRL 的核心前提——我们生成了一个新数据集，其中关节角度根据 D.1.2 节中描述的线性因果模型进行采样。 结构和边权重是随机选择的，并将关节 1、2 和 4 设为根节点。 我们在表 7（第三行）中报告了结果。 我们观察到，引入因果数据生成过程通常会提升性能：与独立双摄像头模型相比，大多数关节的 MSE 值均有所下降。 总体而言，该实验表明基于得分的方法具有灵活性，能够适应关节之间的因果相互作用。

paragraphs.en: To provide a qualitative assessment of our models’ disentanglement capabilities, we visualize the relationship between the learned latent variables and their corresponding ground-truth joint angles. Each plot is generated from the single best trial (out of 15) for that specific joint, determined by the highest MCC score. paragraphs.en: For our experiments, we also compare against a recent supervised baseline. Specifically, we use RoboPEPP ( Goswami et al., 2025 ) , which is among the few alternatives that can predict pose with unknown joint angles at test time (along with HPE ( Ban et al., 2024 ) and RoboPOSE ( Labbé et al., 2021 ) ), and reports stronger results than the alternatives. RoboPEPP involves a two-stage training process. First, a self-supervised I-JEPA backbone is pre-trained on the entire independent ID training dataset in Table 4 . In the second stage, a “JointNet” is trained to predict six joint angles. Its input is formed by concatenating the I-JEPA embeddings from two camera angles, and it is optimized using an L 2 L_{2} loss with the ground-truth joint angle labels. We observe that the MSE of the RoboPEPP baseline decreases with increasing size of labeled data, with our model achieving a comparable performance on joints 1, 2, 4, and 6 to RoboPEPP when using labels of 5% (approx. 6.5K labels and 2 camera orientation per pose = 13K samples) of the entire dataset for training.
paragraphs.zh: 在实验中，我们还与一种近期的监督式基线模型进行了比较。 具体来说，我们使用了 RoboPEPP（Goswami 等人，2025），这是少数能够在测试时预测未知关节角度的替代方法之一（此外还有 HPE（Ban 等人，2024）和 RoboPOSE（Labbé 等人，2021）），并且其报告的结果优于其他替代方法。 RoboPEPP 涉及一个两阶段的训练过程。 首先，在表 4 中列出的整个独立 ID 训练数据集上对自监督的 I-JEPA 主干网络进行预训练。 在第二阶段，训练一个“JointNet”来预测六个关节角度。 其输入由来自两个摄像头角度的 I-JEPA 嵌入向量拼接而成，并使用 L₂（L_{2}）损失与真实关节角度标签进行优化。 我们观察到，随着标注数据规模的增加，RoboPEPP 基线模型的平均平方误差（MSE）会下降；当使用整个数据集的 5%（约 6.5K 个标签和每个姿势 2 种摄像头朝向 = 13K 个样本）作为训练数据时，我们的模型在关节 1、2、4 和 6 上的表现与 RoboPEPP 相当。

paragraphs.en: We pre-train a ViT-Huge model using the I-JEPA objective on 128x128x3 images. The core masking strategy involves one large context block (85-100% scale) and four smaller, non-overlapping target blocks (15-20% scale). The model is trained for 10 epochs with a batch size of 32, using a cosine learning rate schedule with a peak learning rate of 1 ​ e − 3 1e-3 . The target encoder’s weights are updated with an exponential moving average (EMA). Notably, we only use random resized cropping for data augmentation, disabling strong augmentations like color jitter and horizontal flipping. Training is accelerated with bfloat16 mixed-precision.Our training is a two-stage process. In the first stage, we pre-train a ViT-Huge backbone using the I-JEPA self-supervised objective on the full dataset, comprising 260k images, as described previously. For the second stage, we fine-tune our JointNet model for a robotic perception task on the Panda robot. This supervised training uses the smaller RoboPEPP dataset (1%, 5%, 10%, 100%) with a batch size of 8. The model is trained for (100, 75, 25, 15) epochs respectively using a one-cycle learning rate schedule with a maximum learning rate of 1 ​ e − 4 1e-4 and a weight decay of 1 ​ e − 5 1e-5 . Tables 10 , 8 , 9 , 11 and 12 show a detailed comparison of the our and RoboPEPP performance.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 I-JEPA 目标函数在 128x128x3 图像上对 ViT-Huge 模型进行预训练。 核心掩码策略包含一个大的上下文块（85-100% 比例）和四个较小且不重叠的目标块（15-20% 比例）。 该模型以 32 的批量大小训练 10 个周期，采用余弦学习率调度，峰值学习率为 1 ​ e − 3 1e-3。 目标编码器的权重通过指数移动平均（EMA）进行更新。 值得注意的是，我们在数据增强中仅使用随机缩放裁剪，并禁用了颜色抖动和水平翻转等强增强操作。 训练通过 bfloat16 混合精度加速。我们的训练是一个两阶段过程。 在第一阶段，我们按照前述方法，在包含 260k 张图像的完整数据集上，使用 I-JEPA 自监督目标函数对 ViT-Huge 骨干网络进行预训练。 在第二阶段，我们在 Panda 机器人上针对机器人感知任务对我们的 JointNet 模型进行微调。 这种监督训练使用了较小的 RoboPEPP 数据集（1%、5%、10%、100%），批量大小为 8。 该模型分别以 (100, 75, 25, 15) 个周期进行训练，采用单周期学习率调度，最大学习率为 1 ​ e − 4 1e-4，权重衰减为 1 ​ e − 5 1e-5。 表 10、8、9、11 和 12 详细比较了我们的模型与 RoboPEPP 的性能。

sents.en: We pre-train a ViT-Huge model using the I-JEPA objective on 128x128x3 images.
sents.zh: 我们使用 I-JEPA 目标函数在 128x128x3 图像上对 ViT-Huge 模型进行预训练。

sents.en: The core masking strategy involves one large context block (85-100% scale) and four smaller, non-overlapping target blocks (15-20% scale).
sents.zh: 核心掩码策略包含一个大的上下文块（85-100% 比例）和四个较小且不重叠的目标块（15-20% 比例）。

sents.en: The model is trained for 10 epochs with a batch size of 32, using a cosine learning rate schedule with a peak learning rate of 1 ​ e − 3 1e-3 .
sents.zh: 该模型以 32 的批量大小训练 10 个周期，采用余弦学习率调度，峰值学习率为 1 ​ e − 3 1e-3。

sents.en: The target encoder’s weights are updated with an exponential moving average (EMA).
sents.zh: 目标编码器的权重通过指数移动平均（EMA）进行更新。

sents.en: Notably, we only use random resized cropping for data augmentation, disabling strong augmentations like color jitter and horizontal flipping.
sents.zh: 值得注意的是，我们在数据增强中仅使用随机缩放裁剪，并禁用了颜色抖动和水平翻转等强增强操作。

sents.en: Training is accelerated with bfloat16 mixed-precision.Our training is a two-stage process.
sents.zh: 训练通过 bfloat16 混合精度加速。我们的训练是一个两阶段过程。

sents.en: In the first stage, we pre-train a ViT-Huge backbone using the I-JEPA self-supervised objective on the full dataset, comprising 260k images, as described previously.
sents.zh: 在第一阶段，我们按照前述方法，在包含 260k 张图像的完整数据集上，使用 I-JEPA 自监督目标函数对 ViT-Huge 骨干网络进行预训练。

sents.zh: 在第二阶段，我们在 Panda 机器人上针对机器人感知任务对我们的 JointNet 模型进行微调。

sents.en: This supervised training uses the smaller RoboPEPP dataset (1%, 5%, 10%, 100%) with a batch size of 8.
sents.zh: 这种监督训练使用了较小的 RoboPEPP 数据集（1%、5%、10%、100%），批量大小为 8。

sents.en: The model is trained for (100, 75, 25, 15) epochs respectively using a one-cycle learning rate schedule with a maximum learning rate of 1 ​ e − 4 1e-4 and a weight decay of 1 ​ e − 5 1e-5 .
sents.zh: 该模型分别以 (100, 75, 25, 15) 个周期进行训练，采用单周期学习率调度，最大学习率为 1 ​ e − 4 1e-4，权重衰减为 1 ​ e − 5 1e-5。

sents.en: Tables 10 , 8 , 9 , 11 and 12 show a detailed comparison of the our and RoboPEPP performance.
sents.zh: 表 10、8、9、11 和 12 详细比较了我们的模型与 RoboPEPP 的性能。

paragraphs.en: Finally, we evaluate the score-based method’s robustness to corruptions using the trained two-camera model with independent joints. At test time, we introduce artificial occlusions in the form of 32x32 white pixel squares into the input images, and report results for our method and RoboPEPP in Table 10 . Our method was not trained on data containing occlusions or any infilling task. Despite this, our method demonstrates superior robustness to occlusions at test time. This is evident from the MSE of joints 2 and 4, where the performance degradation for our method is significantly less than for RoboPEPP when occlusions are introduced. Furthermore, our method maintains a lower overall MSE on these joints at both 10% and 100% training data labels, highlighting its robustness to this unseen perturbation. Figure 12 visualizes the process. While the initial reconstruction from AE1 clearly shows the occluded patch, the final reconstruction from AE2 successfully inpaints the missing region by leveraging the learned disentangled representation. Table 7 (fourth row) presents the quantitative results for this condition, demonstrating strong performance despite the corruption. A detailed analysis of model performance across varying occlusion sizes is provided in Table 8 .
paragraphs.zh: 最后，我们使用训练好的、具有独立关节的双摄像头模型，评估了基于分数的方法对数据破坏的鲁棒性。 在测试阶段，我们在输入图像中引入以 32x32 白色像素方块形式的人工遮挡，并在表 10 中报告了我们方法与 RoboPEPP 的结果。 我们的方法并未在包含遮挡或任何填充任务的数据上进行训练。 尽管如此，我们的方法在测试阶段对遮挡表现出更强的鲁棒性。 从关节 2 和 4 的 MSE 可以明显看出，当引入遮挡时，我们方法的性能下降显著小于 RoboPEPP。 此外，在训练数据标签为 10% 和 100% 的情况下，我们的方法在这些关节上都能保持更低的总体 MSE，这凸显了它对这种未知扰动的鲁棒性。 图 12 展示了这一过程。 虽然来自 AE1 的初始重建清晰地显示了被遮挡的区域，但来自 AE2 的最终重建通过利用已学习的解耦表示，成功填补了缺失区域。 表 7（第四行）展示了该条件下的量化结果，表明尽管存在数据破坏，该方法仍表现出强劲的性能。 表 8 提供了在不同遮挡尺寸下模型性能的详细分析。

paragraphs.en: We conclude that AE1 is tasked with high-quality reconstruction, while AE2’s loss function sparsifies the score difference. To capture out-of-plane rotations missed by a single camera, an additional viewpoint was essential. This lowered the LDR loss cross-entropy, allowing the model to successfully differentiate all six joint movements.
paragraphs.zh: 我们得出结论：AE1 负责高质量的重建，而 AE2 的损失函数则对分数差异进行稀疏化。 为了捕捉单个摄像头未能检测到的平面外旋转，增加一个额外的视角至关重要。 这降低了 LDR 损失的交叉熵，使模型能够成功区分所有六个关节的运动。

sents.zh: 为了捕捉单个摄像头未能检测到的平面外旋转，增加一个额外的视角至关重要。

sents.zh: 这降低了 LDR 损失的交叉熵，使模型能够成功区分所有六个关节的运动。

paragraphs.en: We conducted a series of experiments to find the proper training setting for our score-based method. Specifically, we investigated the effect of the learning rate, batch size, and weights of the loss components ( λ = 3 \lambda=3 in Equation 9 ) on the model’s ability to disentangle the latent features, as measured by the MCC score. All experiments in this section were performed using Autoencoder-2 with a 2-camera setup on the independent dataset for joint 4.
paragraphs.zh: 我们进行了一系列实验，以找到适用于我们基于得分的方法的合适训练设置。 具体来说，我们研究了学习率、批量大小以及损失项权重（方程9中的 λ = 3 \lambda=3）对模型分离潜在特征能力的影响，该能力通过MCC得分进行衡量。 本节中的所有实验均使用Autoencoder-2，在独立数据集上采用双摄像头配置针对联合任务4执行。

sents.en: We conducted a series of experiments to find the proper training setting for our score-based method.
sents.zh: 我们进行了一系列实验，以找到适用于我们基于得分的方法的合适训练设置。

sents.en: Specifically, we investigated the effect of the learning rate, batch size, and weights of the loss components ( λ = 3 \lambda=3 in Equation 9 ) on the model’s ability to disentangle the latent features, as measured by the MCC score.
sents.zh: 具体来说，我们研究了学习率、批量大小以及损失项权重（方程9中的 λ = 3 \lambda=3）对模型分离潜在特征能力的影响，该能力通过MCC得分进行衡量。

sents.en: All experiments in this section were performed using Autoencoder-2 with a 2-camera setup on the independent dataset for joint 4.
sents.zh: 本节中的所有实验均使用Autoencoder-2，在独立数据集上采用双摄像头配置针对联合任务4执行。

paragraphs.en: First, we analyzed the impact of the learning rate. Figure 13 shows the training progress for different learning rates while keeping the batch size fixed at 128 and the weight of the sparsity loss constant ( λ = 3 \lambda=3 in Equation 9 ). We observe that smaller learning rates, such as 5 ​ e − 5 5e-5 and 8 ​ e − 5 8e-5 , lead to better performance.
paragraphs.zh: 首先，我们分析了学习率的影响。 图 13 展示了在不同学习率下的训练进展，其中批量大小固定为 128，稀疏性损失的权重保持不变（在公式 9 中 λ = 3 \lambda=3）。 我们观察到，较小的学习率，例如 5 ​ e − 5 5e-5 和 8 ​ e − 5 8e-5 ，能带来更好的性能。

sents.en: First, we analyzed the impact of the learning rate.
sents.zh: 首先，我们分析了学习率的影响。

sents.en: Figure 13 shows the training progress for different learning rates while keeping the batch size fixed at 128 and the weight of the sparsity loss constant ( λ = 3 \lambda=3 in Equation 9 ).
sents.zh: 图 13 展示了在不同学习率下的训练进展，其中批量大小固定为 128，稀疏性损失的权重保持不变（在公式 9 中 λ = 3 \lambda=3）。

sents.en: We observe that smaller learning rates, such as 5 ​ e − 5 5e-5 and 8 ​ e − 5 8e-5 , lead to better performance.
sents.zh: 我们观察到，较小的学习率，例如 5 ​ e − 5 5e-5 和 8 ​ e − 5 8e-5 ，能带来更好的性能。

paragraphs.en: Next, we performed an ablation study on the batch size ( Figure 14 ), using the optimal learning rate 5 ​ e − 5 5e-5 found previously. We observed that models with larger batch sizes converged faster; however, their final asymptotic performances were nearly identical, irrespective of the batch size.
paragraphs.zh: 接下来，我们针对批量大小（图 14）进行了消融研究，并使用之前找到的最优学习率 5​e−5。 我们观察到，批量大小较大的模型收敛速度更快；然而，无论批量大小如何，它们最终的渐近性能几乎完全相同。

sents.en: Next, we performed an ablation study on the batch size ( Figure 14 ), using the optimal learning rate 5 ​ e − 5 5e-5 found previously.
sents.zh: 接下来，我们针对批量大小（图 14）进行了消融研究，并使用之前找到的最优学习率 5​e−5。

sents.en: We observed that models with larger batch sizes converged faster; however, their final asymptotic performances were nearly identical, irrespective of the batch size.
sents.zh: 我们观察到，批量大小较大的模型收敛速度更快；然而，无论批量大小如何，它们最终的渐近性能几乎完全相同。

paragraphs.en: We also looked at how to balance the two training objectives: reconstructing the image and the sparsity loss. Figure 15 compares the MCC scores when we vary the weights given to the reconstruction loss versus the sparsity loss. For these experiments, we fixed the learning rate at 5 ​ e − 5 5e{-5} and batch size at 128. The figure shows that giving a significant weight to the score-based loss (i.e., sparsity loss) is crucial for disentanglement. This aligns with our theory that a reconstruction loss alone cannot perform disentanglement (e.g., MCC of less than 0.15 in the figure), but the score-based loss is the main driver of the disentanglement (e.g., over 0.9 MCC in the figure).
paragraphs.zh: 我们还研究了如何平衡两个训练目标：图像重建和稀疏性损失。 图 15 比较了我们在调整重建损失与稀疏性损失的权重时，MCC 分数的变化情况。 在这些实验中，我们将学习率固定为 5 ​ e − 5 5e{-5}，批量大小固定为 128。 该图显示，赋予基于分数的损失（即稀疏性损失）较大的权重，对于解纠缠至关重要。 这与我们的理论一致：仅靠重建损失无法实现解纠缠（例如，图中 MCC 低于 0.15），而基于分数的损失才是解纠缠的主要驱动力（例如，图中 MCC 超过 0.9）。

sents.zh: 我们还研究了如何平衡两个训练目标：图像重建和稀疏性损失。

sents.zh: 这与我们的理论一致：仅靠重建损失无法实现解纠缠（例如，图中 MCC 低于 0.15），而基于分数的损失才是解纠缠的主要驱动力（例如，图中 MCC 超过 0.9）。

paragraphs.en: The inclusion of intra-module residual connections—applied independently within the encoder and decoder architectures—is a key factor for optimal performance. This architectural choice as seen in the Figure 16 improves the reconstruction loss and hence the final MCC score.
paragraphs.zh: 在编码器和解码器架构中独立引入模块内残差连接，是达到最佳性能的关键因素。 如图 16 所示的这种架构选择能够降低重建损失，从而提升最终的 MCC 分数。

sents.zh: 在编码器和解码器架构中独立引入模块内残差连接，是达到最佳性能的关键因素。

sents.en: This architectural choice as seen in the Figure 16 improves the reconstruction loss and hence the final MCC score.
sents.zh: 如图 16 所示的这种架构选择能够降低重建损失，从而提升最终的 MCC 分数。

paragraphs.en: As demonstrated in Table 13 , the model’s Mean Squared Error (MSE) remains stable even when the number of calibration samples is reduced from 1000 to 100.
paragraphs.zh: 如表 13 所示，即使校准样本数量从 1000 减少到 100，该模型的均方误差（MSE）仍然保持稳定。

paragraphs.en: Table 14 evaluates the model’s performance under distinct lighting scenarios, simulated by scaling pixel brightness to 0.8x (dark) and 1.25x (light) of the original. Performance degradation is most pronounced in the dark, particularly for Joint 5 and Joint 6, which exhibit a significant drop in MCC. In contrast, the remaining joints maintain strong performance with only minimal degradation under both conditions.
paragraphs.zh: 表 14 评估了模型在不同光照场景下的性能，这些场景通过将像素亮度缩放至原始亮度的 0.8 倍（暗光）和 1.25 倍（强光）进行模拟。 性能下降在暗光条件下最为明显，尤其是关节 5 和关节 6，其 MCC 值出现了显著下降。 相比之下，其余关节在两种条件下均能保持强劲性能，仅出现轻微的性能下降。

paragraphs.en: Figures 19 and 20 provide a qualitative analysis of our pipeline’s reconstruction performance. Specifically, Figures 19b and 19c compare an original image ( Figure 19a ) to its reconstructions from AE1 and AE2 respectively for the single-camera setup, while Figure 20 shows the equivalent comparison for the two-camera setup. We observe a slight degradation in the reconstruction quality of AE1 when trained on the two-camera dataset compared to the single-camera setup. As the final autoencoder, AE2, is trained on the feature maps from AE1, this reduction in quality of AE1 consequently affects the quality of the final AE2 reconstructions as well. We hypothesize that this performance difference is attributable to the increased data complexity of the multi-view dataset. The inclusion of multiple viewpoints introduces greater visual variance, presenting a more challenging reconstruction task for the autoencoder compared to the more constrained single-view data.
paragraphs.zh: 图 19 和图 20 对我们的管道重建性能的定性分析进行了展示。 具体而言，在单摄像头设置中，图 19b 和图 19c 分别将原始图像（图 19a）与其通过 AE1 和 AE2 重建后的结果进行了比较，而图 20 则展示了双摄像头设置下的类似比较。 我们观察到，与单摄像头设置相比，当 AE1 在双摄像头数据集上进行训练时，其重建质量略有下降。 由于最终自编码器 AE2 是在 AE1 的特征图上训练的，因此 AE1 质量的这种下降也相应地影响了最终 AE2 重建结果的质量。 我们推测，这种性能差异可归因于多视角数据集数据复杂度的增加。 多个视角的引入带来了更大的视觉差异，使得自编码器面临比受更多约束的单视角数据更具挑战性的重建任务。
